exceptionalSingular652.twin: For positive natural conductor and frequency the real exceptional singular expression is the real part of chi at minus one times mu of r over gcd r m times r over phi r phi of r over gcd r m times the first Euler product and the product of one plus one over p minus one over primes dividing m but not r. For a real character the real part is the printed sign. The values at conductor zero or frequency zero are extensions and have no source claim. This numeric definition does not assert the major arc expansion.
